title: feat(app-shell): the console page header folds its actions before it cuts the description (objectui#12705)
body:
Fixes #12705
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

The console page header (`ConsolePageHeader`, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/PageHeader.tsx`) now folds its actions before it cuts its text.

- **Premise, re-measured on main `c41ce3f`.** Setup › Users at 1024 px no longer cuts: since objectui#12606 the Setup posture draws the description on its own line, and it rendered whole ("User accounts for authentication", 256 px of 256) beside Import · Invite User · Create User. The cut still reproduces in the one-row posture: HotCRM Opportunities at 1024 px drew New · Import · Update Stage and cut "Sales opportunities and deals in the pipeline" to 154 of the 284 px it needs. Setup › Packages also cut at 1024 px (374 of 428 px, Import · New Package). The fold lives in the header, so it works in both postures.
- **Target 1 (fold first).** A page may pass a new optional prop, `foldedActions`: the same actions folded, that is the primary action still labelled, then the page's overflow menu holding the others above the page's own entries. The header reads its own width (a `ResizeObserver` on the header plus a pass after every render), never the viewport's. Unfolded, it folds as soon as the title or the description would be clipped. Folded, it unfolds only once the text would still fit after giving `actions` back the width the fold saved, so the two states cannot flip-flop. The description's content width is read through a `Range`, so the description's markup is unchanged. In Setup the title line and the description share one column, and the wider one counts.
- **Target 2 (1280 px).** Measured unchanged at 1280 px: Setup Users (light and dark) keeps three labelled actions; Opportunities, Setup Packages and the object data page keep all of theirs.
- **Target 3 (every mount).** Every caller that draws more than one labelled action now declares its folded face:
  - object lists (`ObjectView.tsx`): the primary is the list's New when it draws one, otherwise the toolbar action authored `variant: 'primary'` (lowest `order` first), so Setup Users keeps Invite User. It is declared, never the first in the row. Everything else goes through one `action:bar` with no inline slots, so the overflow menu is that bar's one menu: the toolbar actions keep the bar's capability, location and visible/disabled gates and its run path, exactly as when they spill past `maxVisible` today. Import, Add to favorites and Reset view join that menu as host callbacks, the way the record page's menu carries Favorite and Share.
  - Setup › Packages (`PackagesPage.tsx`): New Package stays labelled; Import moves into a new overflow menu built from the existing menu primitives (one new string, `engine.packages.moreActions`, en and zh).
  - the object data page (`ObjectDataPage.tsx`): New stays labelled; Save as view moves into a new overflow menu.
  - Every other caller passes one labelled action or none, so it has nothing to fold, and keeps today's behaviour because it passes no `foldedActions`.

## Deviations

- The card says folded actions go above Share / Delete. On a list header the page's own overflow menu holds Add to favorites and Reset view (Share and Delete are on the record page, which is the `page:header` renderer, not this header), so folded actions go above those two entries.
- In the folded face the list's overflow menu is the toolbar bar's menu, not the list's own dropdown. The existing test ids `object-view-more-actions`, `object-view-favorite` and `object-view-reset-view` are unchanged and still drawn in the unfolded face, which every width at which the actions fit shows.
- Files beyond the claim's list: `ObjectDataPage.tsx` (a caller with two actions whose description is cut at 800 px), `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (the one new string), and `packages/app-shell/README.md` (docs for the new prop).
- Overflow members of `action:bar` do not get their `properties.params` evaluated (objectui#11638). A toolbar action folded into the menu shares that existing limit with today's spill past `maxVisible`. Nothing new here.

## Screenshots

HotCRM on platform 18.0.0-next.2 (`objectstack dev --fresh`), the vite console from this branch, Chromium. DOM read at capture:

| Page | Width | Description rendered | Labelled actions |
|---|---|---|---|
| Opportunities (before) | 1024 | cut, 154 of 284 px | 3 |
| Opportunities | 1024 | whole, "Sales opportunities and deals in the pipeline" | 1 (New) |
| Setup Users, light and dark | 1024 | whole, "User accounts for authentication" | 3 (fits, no fold) |
| Setup Users, light and dark | 1280 | whole | 3 |
| Setup Users | 680 | whole | 1 (Invite User) |
| Setup Packages | 1024 | whole, 440 px room for 428 | 1 (New Package) |

## Test evidence

Pinned to `c878e1a`.

- `PageHeader.actionsFold-12705.test.tsx` (7): three actions at a 600 px header render one labelled action plus the overflow trigger and the whole description; at 1280 px all three stay labelled; a folded action in the menu runs its handler and keeps its disabled state; the fold follows resizes both ways; the no-flip-flop band; the Setup posture; CONTROL, a caller passing only `actions` keeps them at 600 px.
- `ObjectView.headerFold-12705.test.tsx` (6): the list's folded face (New labelled; Import, Update Stage, Add to favorites in one menu); Import in the menu opens the import wizard; with no New the `variant: 'primary'` toolbar action stays labelled; 1280 px unfolded; a `?runAction=` deep link runs its action exactly once although the header folds after arrival; `declaredPrimaryToolbarAction` by declaration and order.
- Ablations, each one mutation through an anchor that had to hit, restored to an empty `git diff HEAD`: fold never engages, 8 red; no unfold hysteresis, 6 red; primary taken by row position, 1 red; fold without a declared `foldedActions`, the CONTROL red; deep-link consume-once broken, the exactly-once pin red with 2 calls. A guard that kept the fold off while a deep link was armed stayed green under ablation, so it was removed rather than kept.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, in full on `5c886c9`: exit 0, 1468 files passed and 1 skipped, 13832 tests passed and 9 skipped. The later commits (Packages, the object data page, the changeset) ran 117 targeted app-shell files (1256 tests) and the 16 console test files that reach these components (337 tests), exit 0.
- `type-check`, `build` (app-shell and console), ESLint on every touched file (0 errors), `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check-changeset-presence`: exit 0.
